name: Monitoring Daemon Agent
description: A daemon agent for continuous monitoring and health checks. Tracks system metrics, detects anomalies, and triggers alerts.
author: commit-relay

capabilities.name: Health Monitoring
capabilities.description: Monitor system and agent health status

scaffold.script_template:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# {{agent_name}}-daemon - {{description}}
# Generated from monitoring-daemon template
#

set -euo pipefail

readonly SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
readonly PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"

# Source libraries
source "$PROJECT_ROOT/scripts/lib/agentstudio/agent-register.sh"

# Daemon configuration
readonly DAEMON_NAME="{{agent_name}}"
readonly CHECK_INTERVAL="${CHECK_INTERVAL:-{{check_interval}}}"
readonly METRICS_DIR="coordination/metrics/{{agent_name}}"

mkdir -p "$METRICS_DIR"

#
# Initialize daemon
#
init_daemon() {
    local capabilities='{{capabilities_json}}'
    
    AGENT_ID=$(register_agent \
        "{{agent_class}}" \
        "$DAEMON_NAME" \
        "1.0.0" \
        "$capabilities" \
        "{{description}}")
    
    echo "Daemon registered: $AGENT_ID"
}

#
# Collect metrics
#
collect_metrics() {
    local timestamp=$(date +%s)
    
    # TODO: Implement metric collection logic
    # - CPU usage
    # - Memory usage
    # - Disk usage
    # - Agent health
    
    local metrics='{
        "timestamp": '"$timestamp"',
        "metrics": []
    }'
    
    echo "$metrics" > "$METRICS_DIR/current.json"
}

#
# Check health
#
check_health() {
    # TODO: Implement health check logic
    # - Check agent responsiveness
    # - Check resource usage
    # - Check error rates
    
    local health_status="healthy"
    update_health "$AGENT_ID" "$health_status" "All checks passed" 0
}

#
# Main daemon loop
#
run_daemon() {
    echo "Starting $DAEMON_NAME daemon..."
    echo "Check interval: ${CHECK_INTERVAL}s"
    
    init_daemon
    
    local iteration=0
    
    while true; do
        iteration=$((iteration + 1))
        
        echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] Check #$iteration"
        
        agent_heartbeat "$AGENT_ID"
        collect_metrics
        check_health
        
        sleep "$CHECK_INTERVAL"
    done
}

# Handle signals
trap 'echo "Daemon stopped"; exit 0' INT TERM

# Run if executed directly
if [[ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" == "${0}" ]]; then
    run_daemon
fi

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Description of what this daemon monitors

parameters.name: metrics_retention_days
parameters.description: Number of days to retain metrics
